list.label: A.
list.item: Overthrow of Castro and return to law and order.
list.label: B.
list.item: Re-establishment of Constitution of 1940 with certain amendments.
list.label: C.
list.item: Holding of general elections in eighteen months.
list.label: D.
list.item: The Provisional President will be ineligible to run for elective office in first general elections.
list.label: E.
list.item: Adoption of economic policies designed to increase the national income and raise the standard of living.
list.label: F.
list.item: Stimulation of investments of private capital, both national and foreign, and guarantee free initiative and private ownership in its broadest concept of social function.
list.label: G.
list.item: Establishment of an Agrarian Program which will give full title to the peasants and at the same time provide the former owner a fair price in duly guaranteed bonds.
list.label: H.
list.item: Restore to their legitimate owners the properties seized by the Castro Government, with exception of certain public utilities and other properties which the State considers expropriable in the national interest.
list.label: I.
J.
K.
list.item: Illegalization of the Communist Party and eradication of Communism and all anti-democratic activity.
list.label: L.
list.item: Denunciation of international agreements and treaties which undermine the national sovereignty and place the peace and security of the hemisphere in danger. Immediate resumption of traditional relations with the democratic countries of the world and the fulfillment of legitimate international pacts.
